actions.label: Flow 1 AT
actions.description: No immediate thermal effect. Advance the Thermal Clock by 1 AT.

actions.label: Flow 2 AT
actions.description: No immediate thermal effect. Advance by one baseline Base Beat.

actions.label: Direct Heat
actions.description: Immediately raise Temperature, then advance 1 AT.

actions.label: Direct Cold
actions.description: Immediately lower Temperature, then advance 1 AT.

actions.label: Drift Hot
actions.description: Immediately add Hot-directed Drift, then advance 1 AT.

actions.label: Drift Cold
actions.description: Immediately add Cold-directed Drift, then advance 1 AT.

actions.label: Stabilize
actions.description: Immediately reduce Drift magnitude, then advance 1 AT.

actions.label: Settle Reaction
actions.description: Reaction test: cancel current Drift without advancing world time.

actions.label: Zero AP Active
actions.description: Active zero-cost test. It still advances 1 AT.

actions.label: Action Haste
actions.description: AP and AT differ: a costly action completed in only 1 AT.

actions.label: Long Impact
actions.description: A long action with an impact event at 70% of its timeline.

scenarios.label: T0 Hot Apex
scenarios.description: Natural clock begins at Hot Apex with amplitude 3.

scenarios.label: T1 Hot → Cold
scenarios.description: Midway between Hot Apex and the Cold-directed Set Point crossing.

scenarios.label: T1 Crossing → Cold
scenarios.description: Exactly at Set Point with residual Cold-directed Drift.

scenarios.label: T1 Cold → Hot
scenarios.description: Midway between Cold Apex and the Hot-directed Set Point crossing.

scenarios.label: T4 Settle Opportunity
scenarios.description: Action starts exactly at Set Point; use an immediate Stabilize or Reaction.

scenarios.label: T5 Long Crossing
scenarios.description: Use a 2–3 AT action to cross Set Point and possibly reach an Apex mid-action.

scenarios.label: Warm Set Point +1
scenarios.description: The same clock centered on a warm-blooded Set Point of +1.

scenarios.label: Neutral
scenarios.description: No amplitude and no Drift. The Thermal Clock remains settled until disturbed.
